focus: Iteration 1: the mobile rename -- what a Claude mobile /rename writes, whether a custom-title entry reaches the log prepare reads, why the name is lost on a hop, and what a test or live check needs
answeredQuestions: Mobile rename: when a Claude session is renamed from the mobile app or another remote client, what is written and where, does a `custom-title` entry reach the local session log that `prepare` reads, why would the name not carry over a hop, and what does a test for it need?
noveltyJustification: Six of eight findings are new (the session-store title fields, the missing store reader, the vendor version floor, local store/log survey, the failure-shape analysis, and the smallest change); one is partially new (client attribution) and one is a synthesis of the already-recorded tail cap.
ruledOut: Version floor on this machine (transcripts show 2.1.295-2.1.322, above the 2.1.221 floor)
history.jsonl as a title source (no title field)
~/.claude/transcripts/ses_*.jsonl as a title source (no title field)
Reading the store name regardless of nameSource (would carry the derived title over the launch name)
The 16 MiB tail cap as a mobile-specific cause

graphEvents.label: Session store holds name nameSource and nameSince

label: prepare resolves a Claude name only from the transcript: readClaudeSettings takes the last custom-title then ai-title over a tail that defaults to 256 KiB and widens to 16 MiB; resolveSessionSettings calls it through claudeSessionLogPath, and the pending record ranks settings.name then SKILLED_LOOP_NAME then generatedName.

A second local title store exists at ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json with fields name, nameSource, nameSince and bridgeSessionId; the relaunch code reads no Claude session store (the only sessions directory it reads is Codex's rollout folder), so a title that lands only there is invisible to prepare.

Vendor docs confirm a rename from claude.ai or the Claude app updates the local title shown in claude --resume, requires Claude Code v2.1.221 or later, and ranks the remote title as name flag, then /rename, then last meaningful message, then auto-name; the docs say local title, not transcript custom-title entry.

Local logs contain custom-title (customTitle,sessionId), ai-title (aiTitle,sessionId) and bridge-session (sessionId,bridgeSessionId,lastSequenceNum,ownerAccountUuid,ownerOrganizationUuid); all six live session-store files are interactive and bridged, five have nameSource=user and a matching last customTitle, one is derived with no custom-title; no field records which client renamed, so mobile attribution is unconfirmed.
The vendor version floor is not the cause on this machine: local transcript versions run 2.1.295 to 2.1.322, all at or above 2.1.221; it remains a cause for older installs.

Most likely loss: a remote rename updates the running session store (the local title --resume shows) without a custom-title entry in the transcript, so prepare falls back to SKILLED_LOOP_NAME or ai-title; a rename of a cloud session never touches the local machine at all. Both are silent; the exact operator path is unconfirmed without a live before/after read.
The 16 MiB tail cap is runtime-agnostic and already recorded by 038/012; it can drop any old rename, not a mobile one specifically.

Smallest change: add a Claude session-store reader beside claudeSessionLogPath that matches sessionId, requires nameSource=user and a non-empty name, picks the newest nameSince, and feeds resolveSessionSettings as name when the transcript proves no custom-title; unit test with a store-only name plus a precedence case; one live Remote Control rename with before/after transcript and store reads decides the failure shape.
